title: Yellow Spicy Tunisian Romano Pepper Tagine
description: Earthy and snappy Tunisian dish featuring romano pepper and rest-meat, perfect for meal prep and FODMAP friendly
instructions: Heat the garlic infused oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink, about 5 minutes
Add the smoked paprika, ground cumin, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute
Add the romano peppers and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften, about 5 minutes
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the peppers are tender, about 20 minutes
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired
